row.evidence: Nuclino lists SAML single sign-on (SSO) only on Business ($10/user/month billed yearly), and its SSO guides say a new account is provisioned when a person logs in for the first time via the team URL; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or API reference.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. No SCIM on any plan: SAML SSO (Business, $10/user/month billed yearly) with just-in-time account creation is the only automated provisioning, and members are removed by hand in Team settings. Starter is $6/user/month billed yearly; the pricing page defaults to yearly billing ('up to 25% off') and the monthly prices were not captured. The public REST API (all plans) is read-only for people: GET /v0/users/:id and team listing, with no endpoints to list, invite, update or remove members, so user_api_available is false. Entra's gallery and OneLogin's catalogue list a Nuclino SAML app; Okta and Google Workspace use a custom SAML app per Nuclino's own guides.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 50 items. Comparison table ticks API on every plan (read from page markup), but the API has no user-management endpoints.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Adds SAML SSO, audit log (in-app only) and team insights.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre sitemap (320 pages) or the API reference; SAML JIT is the only automated provisioning. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: A public REST API exists on all plans, but its only user resource is read-only (get one user by id); there are no endpoints to list, invite, update or remove team members.

auth.notes: Personal API key in the Authorization header (optionally Bearer-prefixed) with the same rights as the owning user.

capabilities.notes: False values are by absence from the full API resource list (Users, Teams, Workspaces, Items and Collections, Fields, Files).

audit_log_api.notes: Audit log is an in-app view on Business; no API endpoint documented.

rate_limits.text: 150 requests per minute per API key; 429 with Retry-After.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/nuclino/ returned 404; Nuclino's Okta guide creates an internal SAML app.

entra.notes: Gallery SAML app with JIT; no provisioning tutorial (nuclino-provisioning-tutorial 404).

google.notes: Custom SAML app per vendor guide.

onelogin.notes: Vendor guide adds the Nuclino app from the OneLogin catalogue; OneLogin page not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: jumpcloud.com/support/integrate-with-nuclino returned 403; generic SAML 2.0 should work but is not documented for JumpCloud.

fallbacks.notes: Bulk invite by pasting a list of emails; no CSV user import documented.
